name: for-seven-tubas
description: Bloom — Convergence — Balance, for Tuba Ensemble. Composition system, notation engine and video exporter.
_note: The FIRST dependency in this repo (day 36). Everything else — score server, sandbox, notation engine, every tool — is dependency-free Node and stays that way. resvg is here because PHASE 2.1 measured it: it rasterizes a 1920x1080 notation frame in 172 ms against headless Chrome's 665 ms per process, at equal fidelity. See RUNNING_LOG day 36 for the proof.
